translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Romagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Romanos

content: Dule Jesúsba nagusale, iskuedgi banguer-gebed
¿Degite, igi an sogmalosunna? ¿Anmarde iskudii sadeguode, adi Bab-Dummad-anmargi-nabir-binsa-maid bur-bule oyolegegar?
Suli, degisuli. Ar anmarde iskuedga burgwar gudiyobidde, ¿degite igi anmar bar iskuedgi nanaosunna?
¿Ar be wichurmarsi bela anmar Cristo-Jesús-nuggi digi-ogleged-igar-imaksamaladi, we anmar Cristo-Jesús-burgwisadyob gunonimogad?
Ar anmar Cristoba digi-ogleged-igargi burgwisadyob diglesad, adi Cristo burgwarmalad-abargi maigua, Bab-Dummad-ganguedba gannar durgusadyob, anmar san-binidgi dula gudigumogagar.
Ar anmar Cristo-burgwisadgi eba akanonikid, amba deyob anmar e-durgusadgi eba durgubalodo.
Ar anmar nue wismalad, anmar-san-burba-epennegwad Cristoba nakrusgi bioklesad, anmar-san-iskudiid osulolegegar, adi melle bar iskuedba anmar mailedii-guegar.
Ar dule burgwisale, bato iskued geg bar oakaloged.
Ar Cristoba anmar burgwisale, anmar bensurdo, anmar eba dula gudigubaloed.
Ar anmar wisid, Cristo burgwisgu, gannar durgusad, emi bar burgosulid, burgwed geg bar egi obined.
Ar Cristo burgwisgua, iskued eliega unnila irgwen burgwisad. Ar emi Cristo dula gudiiddi, Bab Dummadga dula gudiid.
Degisoggu, deyob bemar binsamosundo, iskuedga an burgwar gudimarye, an dula gudiiddi, anmar-Dummad-Cristo-Jesúsba Bab Dummadga an dula gudimarye.
Degisoggu, iskued be-san-sunna-berguedgi mer obined be imakmar, galagwensuli-isku-dule-saed imakbiedba, mer be adi eba damalagar.

Deginbali, melle be-san-eba-akanimalad ibmar-iskana-imakegala be imakmar. Bur be Bab-Dummad-urbaligwaa be nanamar, dule burgwis gannar durgusadyob. Deginbali, be-san-eba-akanimalad Bab Dummadga ibmar-nuegan imakegala be imakmarbar.
Ar iskued bar bemargi obinosurmalad, ar ade bemar Moisés-igar-mesisadba bar gudisurmalad, Bab-Dummad-nabir-dulemargi-binsamaid-igarba be gudimalad.
Jesúsba-nanaimalad igar-inikigwadba nanaer-gebed
¿Degite, igi an sogmalosunna? ¿Ar anmarde Moisés-igar-maidba bar gudisurmarsoggu, Bab-Dummad-dulemargi-nabir-binsamaid-igarba anmar emigindi gudimarsoggu, a-ular anmarde iskumarsunde? Suli, degisuli.

¿Ar bemarde wichurmarsi, ar dule-wargwen-sogedba bemar nanadiile, e-maiyob eba be ibmar saele, bemar a-dule-sogedba-be-nanadiid-e-maiga be gunoni-damalad? A-ulale, iskued-sogedba be nanadiile, be burgwemalodo, ar Bab-Dummad-sogedba be nanaerdi, dule-inikigwadga be gumalodo.
Ar Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye anmar sogsun, ar bemar iskued-maiga gudiinad, degite igar-nued-bemarga-soglesad, a-igarba napiragwadba bemar nanaded.
Degine, iskuedgi bemar onolenonimargu, bemar igar-inikii-imaked e-maiga gunonimarsunnad.

An-bemarga-sunmakedi, ar bemar aku-itomalad-ular dulemar-sunmakedyob an sunmaked. Igi ibmar-iskanaga be-san-eba-akanimalad be ukdii-gusmala, ibmar-sunnasulid imakega, degi, ibmar-iskana gatik imakega, deyob emigi be-san-eba-akanimalad be ukmarbar, igar-inikigwad-maidba bemar ibmar-nuegan imakmalagar, adi na be san-swilidik gumalagar.
Ar bemar iskued-maiga gudimargua, igar-inikii-imakedgi deun bemar bachik gudigusmalad.
Degite, ¿ibi-nued egi be amismarsunna, emi egi be bingegudimaladgi? Ar wemardi unnila burgwedse dule-nimalad.
Emigindi iskuedgi be onolenonimalad, Bab-Dummad-maiga be gunonimaladgi, bega wedi ibmar-nuedga gunonimardo, be san-swilidikid gunonimarsundo, adi burba-geg-bergued bemar nikumalagar.
Ar ade iskued anmar-bennuked, burgwedgi. Bab-Dummad-nabir-anmargi-binsamaiddi, anmar-Dummad-Cristo-Jesúsgi burba-geg-bergued anmarga uked.
